## Security verdict: PASS

PR #179, exact head `81dd2f36fc76f441774b7a01f5bc72473be3a424`.

The complete small diff is test/documentation-only: render polling in `crates/tmux/tests/adapter.rs:177,1463-1483`, fixture polling in `crates/tmux/tests/control_mode.rs:58-71`, and explanatory text in `docs/difficulties.md:103`. No product code or production behavior changes.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerability identified | - |

Both polls have 15-second deadlines and 20ms intervals; isolated-server teardown remains intact. No fixture secret, private machine path, C19/C21 disclosure or harmful shell/argument interpolation was introduced.

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42447292932` and Delivers run `42447292848` both identify this SHA and success.

No local tests, builds, tmux operations, probes, credential reads or mutations were performed.
